observations.concept: Concept has comparatively broad, ginkgo-like leaf fans and a heavy tree axis. The original frozen brief explicitly rejects those features. The final geometry is not accepted on concept resemblance alone.
observations.source: Hao et al. 2003 primary article text, on its publisher abstract and author-uploaded full-text page, supports tiny strongly divided blades on axes, occasional paired leaves, and uncertainty in their three-dimensional form. The inspected seven-panel fossil plate is a secondary-hosted reproduction attributed to Hao and Xue 2013, not an accessed original publisher plate.

views.hero: Slender open axes, attached terminal paired leaf clusters, no broad continuous ginkgo blades; grounded basal stem.
views.reversehero: Opposite side shows branching depth and terminal leaf attachments without a planar billboard.
views.front: Small leaf units remain subordinate to the three-axis framework; incised margins read as thin divided lobes.
views.side: Nonzero depth with projected branch overlap; no visibly floating lateral or detached leaf fan.
views.rear: Reverse branching and foliage are consistent with hero; no hidden-sheet substitution.
views.top: Radially spaced shoots and three-dimensional leaf poses; pair overlaps do not become a continuous canopy.
views.clay: Volumetric axis caps and thin solid leaves remain coherent without palette cues.
views.silhouette: Open branching structure and divided terminal margins; no visible framing clipping or detached patches.

observations.judgment: Pass within selected-axis artistic reconstruction scope. Whole habit, exact 12 pairs, palette and scale remain artistic. Fine unequal laminar divisions are small at 512px, not evidence of anatomical venation or a literal fossil replica.
observations.component_summary: 24 nonempty single-connected leaf groups on 12 terminal shoots. Actual projected longitudinal spans 3.288803–4.000001 mm and transverse spans 2.934385–3.305769 mm satisfy the original 2.2–5 and 1.7–4.8 mm hard intervals. Paired material thickness is approximately 0.120 mm; folded normal extent was separately measured and is not misused as the thickness requirement.

observations.concept: The generated image contains photoreal surface speckling and relief-like cut clots. Frozen choices instead call for a texture-free faceted mound and diagrammatically enlarged, integrated clotted cut.
observations.source: UGS Special Study 168 text and actual PDF pages 22–23 were inspected, including Figure 10 mound, Figure 11 core and clotted micrograph, and oncoid contrasts. The source distinguishes clotted internal fabric from lamination; a cut face at model scale is illustrative rather than a literal micrograph extruded into rock. UGS was an explicitly frozen replacement for unavailable inventory USGS sources.

views.hero: One squat solid mound with front cut; irregular branching dark/light fabric remains on the cut rather than stacked horizontal laminae.
views.reversehero: Continuous domed rear; visible regular facet rows are exterior low-poly shading, not painted diagnostic stromatolite bands.
views.front: Connected irregular clot patches in a continuous matrix; no parallel internal lamination, detached pebble overlays or apparent doubled faces.
views.side: Cut wall closes into the rounded rear with a grounded bottom; silhouette is coherent.
views.rear: Single closed faceted arch volume; no separate plane or open shell exposed.
views.top: Continuous mound footprint and mildly irregular faceted contour; no floating cut component.
views.clay: Solid integrated cut confirms full-volume surface; internal color fabric deliberately disappears in clay, as a planar geological section should.
views.silhouette: One intact squat volume with no detached fragments or framing clipping.

observations.judgment: Pass as a stylized pedagogical cutaway, not a naturalistic locality specimen. Exterior is deliberately simplified and its facet grid remains noticeable. No new universal prohibition on regular meshing is imposed; diagnostic internal clots, not the external facet grid, govern this frozen scope.

observations.concept: Concept supports separate rounded grains and three visible cuts, but its numerous photoreal small pebbles and uniform onion-like rings are not factual requirements. Original freeze chooses 16 grains, three uneven internal coating exposures and a quiet shallow base.
observations.source: UGS Figure 12 polished slab and Figure 13 core show separate coated grains and nuclei. The primary Hydra article oncoid subsection describes irregular, roughly concentric, partially overlapping coatings and asymmetric forms. Its 1.8–4.1 mm locality grain sizes are not applied to this explicitly generic artistic centimetre-scale teaching bed.

views.hero: Three front cuts have distinct nuclei and uneven interrupted coatings; intact grains remain separate rounded volumes.
views.reversehero: Rear grains have faceted rough exteriors rather than exposed cortical rings painted around every sphere.
views.front: All three cut faces are readable with separated nuclei; bed remains subordinate.
views.side: Shallow support slab and rounded grain depth are clear; no floating cut planes.
views.rear: Rounded closed backs show facet lighting, not internal cortical band material; grain-base contact is visually coherent.
views.top: Sixteen identifiable grain locations, with some normal contact/overlap; no continuous fused mound.
views.clay: Three geometric cuts remain flat within otherwise full-volume grains; contacts show no visible coplanar flicker pattern.
views.silhouette: Subordinate shallow bed supports solid grain profiles with no detached floating outlines.

observations.judgment: Pass for generic geological teaching asset. Coating rings are section-only; the exterior facet palette and repeated rounded modules are stylized, not a claim of exact natural surface texture. Normal intersecting contact volumes are not rejected absent a visible defect.
observations.component_summary: Actual connectivity yields 17 closed source shells: sediment plus 16 grains. Three cut-grain groups correspond to actual grain shells. Actual whole bounds 0.244806 × 0.180000 × 0.052606 m are inside the original hard ranges.

observations.concept: Concept incorrectly suggests distal longitudinal slits and a heavier woody axis. The original freeze rejects this and requires proximal mouth/lip directions on near-subopposite pairs.
observations.source: Taylor and Taylor 2009 primary review text supports a slender axis with subopposite stalked recurved cupules and a lip towards attachment. The inspected official Shi et al. 2021 Extended Data Figure 6 pixels and locally retained official caption show two ranks, compressed cupules, proximal lips and no individual subtending bracts. Elgorriaga et al. 2019 primary text retains whole-plant association and habit uncertainty.

views.hero: Twelve compact rounded cupules on six paired levels, attached by slender lateral stalks; no distal egg slit.
views.reversehero: Reverse body surfaces and stalks remain coherent; cupules are solids, not paired picture planes.
views.front: Six near-subopposite pairs and a slender central axis are readily countable; mouths are mostly edge-on at this angle.
views.side: Compressed but nonzero volumetric depth is evident; paired cupules overlap in projection as expected for two ranks.
views.rear: Closed rounded back faces, no speculative seeds or whole-plant foliage.
views.top: Shallow three-dimensional stalk/cupule pose and small proximal rim/attachment relationships can be seen; depth is not a zero-thickness sheet.
views.clay: Rounded compressed cupules and thin real stalks persist without material cues.
views.silhouette: Twelve separated cupule profiles on one reproductive axis, without roots, fruit slits or foliage.

observations.judgment: Pass as isolated reproductive organ. Tiny proximal lips are not prominent in the full-asset 512px hero, so these stills are not a close-up anatomy plate. Actual rim-to-centroid direction was independently measured against actual stalk-root vertices, not trusted from a config direction. No whole-plant or angiosperm-fruit interpretation is approved.
observations.component_summary: 12 cupules across six pair levels and 12 stalk groups. Every actual mouth direction points towards its actual attachment, minimum cosine >0.9999999999998. Actual Y thickness 4.767148 mm is within original 4–14 mm interval; XYZ are 21.426361 × 4.767148 × 52.028053 mm.
